### Fixed

- **Slide apart works on fading words too.** Words that are fading out now glide out of the way as well, and new words no longer land on top of them.
- **Lyrics come back after switching servers.** Leaving one server and joining another no longer leaves the World words stuck until the next song.
- **Song library cards stay in place when hovered.** Cards in the top row used to rise up under the header and over each other; now they just light up.

### New

- **Words keep clear of other players.** In the World layout, new words pick a spot that does not cover other players, so they don't get in the way in PvP.
